title: 3D opening title crawl
blurb: Map a tall editable HTML article and interactive chapter buttons onto a 3D receding cinema crawl plane in one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas, fading into a deep starfield horizon while projective updateElementGeometry() keeps controls clickable.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas render a true 3D perspective receding opening title crawl from a live editable multi-paragraph HTML article and interactive action buttons, fading smoothly into a deep starfield horizon while keeping the scrolled and tilted DOM clickable via projective updateElementGeometry()?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 1.22 MP and 9.8 MB on one ElementGL context, zero CLS, and elementsFromPoint() hits tilted buttons at both 0° and 50°–55°.
